name: Dublin Police Services Teen Academy
what_you_do: A free week-long morning course where teens learn about criminal justice and law enforcement and tour local law enforcement stations.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 18 interested in criminal justice. You must pass a background check and have parent consent. Up to 25 teens.
duration: One week. In 2026 it ran June 8 to 12, 9 a.m. to noon.
deadline_text: 2026: applications were due Friday, May 29 at 5 p.m. for the June 8 to 12 session. 2027 dates are not posted yet. Expect a late May deadline again.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application form linked on the Teen Academy page. Questions: Crime Prevention Unit, 925-833-6677 or 925-833-6686.
notes: Formerly called the Youth Academy. The 2026 form link was dublin.ca.gov/FormCenter/Dublin-Police-Services-8/2026-Dublin-Police-Services-Teen-Academy-449; a new form will likely be posted for 2027. Dublin Police Services address: 6361 Clark Avenue, Dublin.
